newsitem.title: USA: Promus Hotel in pact with FelCor.
newsitem.headline: Promus Hotel in pact with FelCor.

text.p: Promus Hotel Corp said Monday FelCor Suit Hotels would invest approximately $100 million for the acquisition of five to 10 new Embassy Suites hotels to be developed by Promus Hotels.

As part of the agreement, Promus said it will sell the existing Embassy Suites hotels in Dallas at Market Center and Syracuse, N.Y., to FelCor Suite Hotels for $46 million. The hotels will be franchised to FelCor under 20-year licenses and will be managed by Promus.

For each of the new hotels, Promus and FelCor will form individual partnerships, with FelCor being the majority owner. Promus will take a 10 percent share in each partnership. Each property will be developed by Promus and then acquired by the partnership upon completion of the project. Promus will manage all of the new hotels.
